# Detrended Price Oscillator

*Close minus a lagged SMA, to show cycles without the trend.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Detrended Price Oscillator** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `21` |
| Color | color | `"#43A047"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/dpo.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Detrended Price Oscillator", shortTitle: "DPO", overlay: false });
const period = input.int("Length", 21, { min: 1 });
const barsback = math.floor(period / 2) + 1;
const ma = ta.sma(candle.close, period);
plot(ta.calc([candle.close, ma], (c) => c - ma.at(barsback)), { title: "Detrended Price Oscillator", color: input.color("Color", "#43A047", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
